text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Defeated by the hero Aston Machan,
the Demon
King uttered his last words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The truth is... I was once a hero myself.
And I will
stop at nothing to accomplish
my mission."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, done. This live reading of "The

Adventures of Machan the Hero" is over.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That's soooo cool! The Demon
King used to
be a hero?!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
'Scuse me, but when can we hear the
rest of the
Demon King's story?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, the Demon King is more popular
than the
main character at this point.
And I stayed up all
night writing this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is disappointed by the
children's
unexpected response to her
story...
